gist.summary: Removed the outdated AGENTS_AND_MCP.md architecture guide and its link from DEVELOP.md. BRING_YOUR_OWN_MODEL.md now explains that Gen calls endpoint agents with an `ag_` run token valid for up to 30 minutes instead of forwarding the caller’s key; the token carries that key’s permissions and budget, and the agent server can check it with `GET /account/key`. BUILD_YOUR_OWN_AGENT.md no longer tells developers to reword identical test requests to avoid caching.
